Perched high above the city in the highly desirable gated community of Sunset Ridge in Canyon Crest, this beautifully upgraded 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers approximately 1,789 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with breathtaking panoramic city-light and hillside views. Expansive windows fill the home with natural light, highlighting rich wood flooring throughout and creating a warm, inviting atmosphere.
Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, the well-designed floor plan features multiple outdoor spaces, including a private patio overlooking panoramic city-light views and two private balconies that provide the perfect setting for spectacular sunsets and sparkling evening skylines.
Living in Sunset Ridge offers a truly low-maintenance lifestyle. HOA dues include structural insurance, exterior maintenance, water, professional landscaping, pool service, and gopher pest control. Residents also enjoy two sparkling swimming pools, a tennis court, beautifully maintained grounds, and freshly paved private streets.
The main living area is ideal for everyday living and entertaining, featuring a cozy fireplace, motorized remote-controlled blinds in the living and dining rooms, and a built-in wine refrigerator. A professionally installed 5.1 surround sound system with in-ceiling speakers, an in-wall subwoofer, integrated media wiring, AT&T media routing, and an included amplifier delivers premium audio throughout.
The spacious primary suite features a custom walk-in closet and private balcony overlooking the Riverside skyline—an ideal place to enjoy peaceful mornings, colorful sunsets, and sparkling nighttime city views. The finished garage includes an epoxy-coated floor, custom built-in cabinetry, workbench, generous attic storage, and a smart sensor-activated cooling fan.
Ideally located just minutes from UC Riverside, Canyon Crest Towne Centre, Sycamore Canyon Wilderness Park, scenic hiking and biking trails, golf courses, shopping, restaurants, coffee shops, healthcare facilities, and convenient access to the 91 and 60 freeways.
Whether you're looking for a primary residence, a low-maintenance luxury home, or a long-term investment, this exceptional property combines panoramic views, premium upgrades, resort-style amenities, and an outstanding Canyon Crest location. Be sure to review the attached Features & Upgrades List to fully appreciate the extensive enhancements that make this home truly move-in ready.

Welcome to 6754 Palm Ave, a rare opportunity in Riverside with a massive lot, solid structural upgrades, and endless potential. Whether you’re an investor looking for your next value-add project or a homeowner ready to put in some work and make it your own, this property delivers space, infrastructure, and upside.

This 4-bedroom, 2-bath single-story home sits on an expansive lot with room for additions, outdoor living, RV parking, storage, or future improvements. The home needs some TLC, but the big-ticket items have already been handled.

Major Upgrades Already Completed:
- New roof installed just over a year ago
- Newer AC system (approx. 4 years old)
- 28 solar panels + 2 battery backups
- Underground drainage system added with cleanouts tied into the laterals
- Garage currently walled off, but with a floating wall that can be easily removed to restore full garage functionality
- Solar system includes 28 panels plus two battery backups, providing substantial energy support and resilience. System is under a transferable solar lease, and buyer must qualify for and assume the lease as part of the purchase. Seller notes meaningful monthly savings; however, buyer should independently verify all cost reductions, lease obligations, and system specifications with the solar provider. Broker and seller make no warranties regarding solar output or financial performance.

Lot & Location:
HUGE lot with room to expand

Zoning: R-1-7000: (Single-Family Residential, minimum 7,000 sq ft lot). Buyer and buyer’s agent to verify all zoning, use, and permit possibilities directly with the City of Riverside.

Residential home on one side

Commercial residential care facility (senior home) behind and adjacent

Ideal for buyers wanting privacy, space, or potential future improvements (subject to city approval)

Why This Property Is Special
- Perfect for investors, contractors, or DIY buyers
- Major systems already updated
- Solar + batteries provide long-term energy savings
- Large lot offers flexibility and future potential
- Located in a quiet pocket of Riverside with mixed residential surroundings

This is a home with great bones, major upgrades, and a lot that’s hard to find in today’s market. With some vision and effort, 6754 Palm Ave can become a standout property—whether as a personal residence or an investment.

results.remarks:
Located in Riverside's Historic Wood Streets, this 1,159 square foot, 3 bedroom, 2 bath Craftsman bungalow pairs the character you can't recreate with the updates buyers are looking for today. A brick paver walkway leads past drought tolerant landscaping and an automatic wrought iron gate to the covered front porch, framed by the home's original craftsman trim and brick chimney.

Inside, real wood floors run through the living and dining rooms, where a tiled fireplace and the home's original built-in cabinetry set the tone. French doors and a wall of windows keep the space bright, and the dining room's built-in hutch adds the kind of detail you don't find in new construction. The third bedroom includes a built-in Murphy bed, giving the room flexible use as a guest space, office, or den.

The Chef's Kitchen has been completely remodeled with custom cabinetry, granite counters, a farmhouse sink, recessed lighting, and a stainless appliance suite that includes a built-in double oven and electric cooktop set against a herringbone tile backsplash. The jack and jill bathroom between two of the bedrooms has been fully renovated with a new vanity and a tiled walk-in shower, and a second full bathroom serves the rest of the home. Indoor laundry adds everyday convenience.

Out back, the 9,148 square foot lot (0.21 acres) is set up for real outdoor living: Cedar Pergola wired with electricity and a mounted TV, a tiled fire pit, a porch swing, more than 20 producing fruit trees and plants, and three sheds for storage. A Tesla EV charger and a separate 220 volt outlet are already installed, and there's room to explore ADU or RV storage potential.

Just minutes from downtown Riverside, Mt. Rubidoux, and neighborhood parks, this move-in ready bungalow offers the character of Wood Streets living with the updates that make everyday life easy. Contact us to schedule your private showing.

Welcome to Riverpointe at Park Place.  From the moment you step inside, soaring ceilings, sunlit living spaces, and an open, airy floor plan create an immediate sense of home.

Designed for gathering, the kitchen seamlessly connects to the great room, creating a space where conversation flows as easily as everyday life. This chef-inspired kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, quartz countertops, an oversized island with seating, with tons of generous storage. 

Need a dedicated workspace? The upstairs loft/flex area offers the ideal work-from-home setup with beautiful valley views through oversized windows. The spacious primary suite provides a peaceful retreat complete with dual vanities, oversized walk-in shower, and a generous walk-in closet. Two additional well-proportioned bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, fitness space, or hobbies. Thoughtfully equipped for comfort and efficiency, the home also features a whole house fan, tankless water heater, and leased solar to help keep energy costs low. Built with Indoor airPLUS certification, offering enhanced indoor air quality and energy-efficient construction for healthier, more comfortable living.

Step outside to a thoughtfully designed backyard that proves low maintenance doesn't mean sacrificing enjoyment. Artificial turf accents, attractive hardscape, and comfortable seating areas create the perfect space to enjoy morning coffee, relax around the fire table, or unwind beneath the café lights.

Beyond your front door, you'll love being surrounded by some of Riverside's favorite outdoor destinations. Spend weekends exploring the scenic trails of nearby Hidden Valley Wildlife Area and Mount Rubidoux, enjoy neighborhood parks, playgrounds, and greenbelts, or take advantage of nearby shopping, dining, golf, schools, and convenient freeway access for an easy commute. Whether you're hiking, biking, enjoying local parks, or simply taking in the Southern California sunshine, this location embraces an active lifestyle.

Modern construction. Energy-efficient design. Turnkey condition. A flexible floor plan. An unbeatable combination of comfort, convenience, and lifestyle—this is the one you've been waiting for!!

Welcome to 7800 Maria Drive,  where space, character, and opportunity come together in the heart of Jurupa Valley!
Lovingly owned by the same family for approximately 40 years, this home is ready for a new chapter. Whether you're looking for a place to make your own or an investment opportunity with plenty of potential, this property offers a great foundation to bring your vision to life.
Inside, you'll find a spacious and functional floor plan with multiple living and gathering areas, giving you flexibility for everyday living, entertaining, a home office, or additional lounge space. The main living area features a classic brick fireplace and flows into the dining area, while a second casual living space sits conveniently alongside the kitchen and breakfast bar, ideal for keeping everyone connected.
And then there's the character! An original wet bar with mirrored shelving gives the home a fun retro touch and creates a unique entertaining space that today's cookie-cutter homes simply don't have. Keep the vintage vibe or give it a modern refresh and make it your own.
Large windows and sliding glass doors bring in natural light and connect the interior to the backyard, where there's room for barbecues, entertaining, gardening, pets, or simply enjoying Southern California's outdoor lifestyle. The property also offers an attached two-car garage and generous driveway parking.

Location adds even more appeal. Enjoy convenient access to the nearby golf course, shopping, dining, fitness, and everyday essentials. A new gym is within a short distance, Starbucks is nearby, and a new Sprouts Farmers Market is coming soon to Jurupa Valley.

Bring your ideas. Bring your vision. 7800 Maria Drive is ready for what comes next. Per Seller's request, no open houses will be held. Private showings will be available by appointment only

results.remarks: This 1927 Tudor Revival is storybook perfect and ready for a new chapter!  Gleaming original hardwood floors and barrel-vaulted ceilings greet you as you enter. For the first time in decades, this well-loved home is hitting the market! Owned and cared for by the same family since it was built, 19625 Tangelo Dr offers a rare opportunity in one of Riverside’s established neighborhoods. The main home features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, vaulted ceilings, and a warm, inviting layout filled with natural light. Thoughtful improvements over the years include granite kitchen countertops, recessed lighting, upgraded bathroom lighting, tile flooring, an updated fireplace mantel, dual-pane windows, and a newer HVAC system.
Outside, the property really stands apart. Mature landscaping and 4 planted trees create a beautiful, serene setting, while a covered patio, concrete walkways on both sides of the home add function and usability. The backyard also features a detached permitted casita with a spacious open room, large walk-in closet, and private bathroom with shower an excellent flexible space for guests, extended family, a home office, gym, or studio. 
Additional improvements include built-in garage shelving, a low-threshold Safe Step shower in the primary bathroom, and a ramp to access casita. With its long history of pride of ownership, extensive improvements, mature grounds, and versatile detached casita, this is a property that has been truly loved and cared for by one family and is now ready for its next chapter. Centrally located near parks, shopping, dining, and entertainment, this home offers the perfect combination of space, comfort, and convenience.

results.remarks: Tucked away on a desirable corner lot within the secure gates of the Atherton Square community, this tastefully upgraded 2007-built residence offers a pristine, turnkey living experience. Stepping inside, you are greeted by an expansive, airy living area that flows effortlessly into a dedicated dining space, perfect for both relaxing evenings and lively hosting. The thoughtfully designed layout features three bedrooms and two and a half baths, including a generous primary retreat complete with a walk-in closet, dual vanities, a deep soaking tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower. At the heart of the home, the updated kitchen boasts freshly updated quartz countertops, plenty of cabinets, and sleek stainless steel appliances, while a built-in whole-house fan naturally draws in cool air to keep utility costs more manageable. Practical features include an individual laundry room and a direct-access two-car garage. Beyond your front door, the neighborhood provides resort-style amenities including a sparkling pool, spa, clubhouse, playground, volleyball court, and park spaces. Location is everything here: you are just minutes from local schools, shopping centers, medical facilities, and major commuter freeways, with the University of California, Riverside campus only four miles away. Complete with a low tax rate, this immaculate property beautifully combines modern convenience, comfort, and exceptional value.
